name: NexoPeek
summary:
From curious science enthusiasts to veteran drug discovery teams, NexoPeek empowers anyone to step inside and
  interact with the 3D world of molecules in VR. Journey through guided tours across six pillars: biotechnology basics
  that teach you to read molecules, the foundations of life with ATP and hemoglobin, pathways and interactions like
  glycolysis and trypsin, medicines in action from aspirin and caffeine to penicillin, genetic technologies including
  CRISPR and Yamanaka factors, and green biotech
